concepts.proposed_markdown: Separately from the Stripe-hosted Avalara tax-app path, bearer-authenticated `POST /v1/upsertAvalaraCredentials` maps Avalara credentials to billing-provider `delivery_method_ids` returned by `/listConfiguredBillingProviders`, associating them with the appropriate billing entities. The endpoint limits these credentials to PLG Invoicing at this snapshot. Its JSON object schema requires the delivery-method IDs, Avalara environment (`PRODUCTION` or `SANDBOX`), username, and password; optional `commit_transactions` controls whether Metronome tax calculations are committed for reporting and tax filings. The enclosing `requestBody` is not marked required, and the empty-object `200` response does not expose per-delivery-method outcomes. [[source-metronome-api-reference-settings-upsert-avalara-credentials]]
warnings: Keep this PLG Invoicing credential path separate from the existing Stripe-hosted Avalara guide and do not import Anrok Threshold Billing scope.
